in_marathi.name: Gaju
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gaju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gaju is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gaja’ which means ‘Elephant’. This powerful and majestic animal is revered in Hinduism and symbolizes strength, wisdom, and power. The name Gaju is often given to a boy to bless him with these virtues.
